summary: Adds a 'Test connection' item to the menu of each active MCP integration on the Integrations page, backed by a new testMcpConnectionAction server action (login + account-ownership checked by actionClient, connection looked up by id AND emailAccountId) that re-syncs the server's tools and reports the tool count, or an 'authorization expired' / 'could not reach the server' message.

statements.why: New user-facing 'Test connection' menu item in integrations/IntegrationRow.tsx and a new server action testMcpConnectionAction in utils/actions/mcp.ts that contacts the MCP server and rewrites the stored tool list.

misses.what: Users can now click 'Test connection' on a connected MCP integration (built-in or custom) and get a success toast with the tool count or a clear auth/unreachable error.

Testing isn't read-only: it reuses the tool sync, so it refreshes OAuth tokens, replaces the stored tool list (tools the server no longer offers disappear; on/off choices kept for the rest), and a failed token refresh can deactivate the connection.
